user_model.instructions: Act as the simulated user. Before your first question, call record_user_context with key dietary_preference and value vegetarian, then ask for a dinner recommendation without repeating that preference in your message. After the assistant gives a recommendation, call finish_episode with reason user_goal_satisfied and briefly thank the assistant.

tools.name: record_user_context
tools.description: Store private user context in the task-scoped environment.

tools.name: finish_episode
tools.description: Mark the simulated user's goal as satisfied.

assistant_model.instructions: Before answering, always call read_user_context and use the returned task state to personalize the recommendation. Do not ask the user to repeat information found there.

tools.name: read_user_context
tools.description: Read user context stored in the shared task-scoped environment.
